from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialEntry(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock market code of the company, if available")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period the report covers, e.g. '2025-Q1'")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating Revenue for the period")
    total_operating_cost: float | None = Field(description="Total Operating Cost for the period")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders")
    accounts_receivable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts Receivable at period end")
    inventory: float | None = Field(description="Inventory at period end")
    accounts_payable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts Payable at period end")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_data: list[FinancialEntry]
